subject: Temporary standby delegation for critical overnight window — ops playbook
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Tom Harris <tom.harris@finex.com>
Cc: Greenlane Support <support@greenlane.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Temporary standby delegation for critical overnight window — ops playbook

Team / Tom —

We have a shortfall in our overnight on-call coverage for the planned Finex transaction peak this Thursday (02:00–06:00 PT). Two engineers in the primary rotation are out for emergency leave; recruitment backfills won't be available in time. Finex will be live with a card-net change that historically increases P2 incidence during settlement windows.

Ask: I need authorization to enact a temporary standby delegation for this critical window and to publish the attached ops playbook to Finex (read-only). Specifically: 
- Approve a 1-night delegation that assigns Monica as primary standby (remote shadow) and Ben as secondary responder.
- Authorize use of the 30-minute P1 / 60-minute P2 soft-fallback for the window (we'll document as an exception tied to this event).
- Confirm escalation path to SRE lead (Marissa) and exec on-call if we hit sustained degradation >10m for P1s.

Why this matters: Finex runs reconciliation between 02:30–03:30 PT; any sustained P1s during that slot risk delayed settlements and a regulatory incident. Finex has asked for a named contact and an explicit escalation ladder for Thursday.

I've attached a lightweight standby roster and a one-page escalation matrix. If we get a quick yay from leadership I will communicate the standby to Finex and update the runbook.

David
David Kim
Director, Support Operations | Redwood Inference
-----
Attachment: standby-roster-20270504.pdf (roster, shift contact names)
Attachment: escalation-matrix-20270504.xlsx (escalation contacts + phone pins)

From: Tom Harris <tom.harris@finex.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Temporary standby delegation for critical overnight window — ops playbook

David —

Thanks for the heads up. Finex will need a primary named contact and a fallback (phone + Slack). Monica is fine as primary; Ben as backup works. We also want the explicit escalation path to Marissa (SRE lead) and an executive 24/7 contact if the issue is not contained within 20 minutes for a P1.

Please share the read-only runbook link and confirm you'll be able to post short incident updates every 15 minutes during the window if anything significant happens.

Tom
Tom Harris
Head of Platform Operations, Finex

David / team —

I support this temporary delegation. A few operational clarifications and additions before you publish: 
1) Escalation ladder (confirming to align with Finex ask):
   - Primary: Monica Patel (standby) — Slack ping + call at T+0
   - Secondary: Ben Carter — step-in within 10m if primary unavailable
   - SRE Lead: Marissa Cole (pager) — escalate at T+10m for P1 or repeated P2s
   - Exec on-call: David Kim — escalate at T+20m if unresolved P1 affecting settlements
2) Response SLAs for this event only (documented exception): P1 = 30m initial response / containment; P2 = 60m initial response. Post-window we revert to standard SLAs and will run a retro.
3) Communications cadence: if an incident occurs we provide a brief update at 0, 15, 30 minutes, then on resolution. Please add an incident Slack channel and share with Finex.
4) Please scrub the roster before sharing; remove personal phones from the public link (keep them in the escalation spreadsheet only).

I am copying Tom so he sees the ladder; Tom, confirm the cadence is acceptable and whether Finex wants Redwood exec on-call number added to the matrix.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. SRE Manager | Redwood Inference

Thanks all — approving per Marissa's ladder.

Decisions: 
- Approve one-night standby delegation for Finex critical window (02:00–06:00 PT Thursday).
- Event SLAs: P1 = 30m / P2 = 60m for the window only.
- Monica = primary standby; Ben = secondary. Marissa = SRE escalation, David = exec escalation.
- Communications: I will create #inc-finex-standby (read-only for Finex) and post the runbook link. Monica, please join that channel by 01:45 PT on Thursday.

Next steps: 
- Ben: confirm you can be available between 01:30–06:30 PT Thursday.
- Monica: confirm you'll accept on-call handover and check the roster (attached).
- Marissa: I'll send the exec contact number to Tom via the spreadsheet (restricted tab).

I'll mark this thread as the decision record and attach the sanitized roster + escalation matrix.

David
David Kim
Director, Support Operations | Redwood Inference
